'''Troy Biesterfeld''' (forums handle '''tbiesty''') forked Star Wars CCG from [[GEMP]].<ref name="t52222" /> [[Marcin Sciesinski]] created the GEMP engine in 2011.<ref name="t7301" /> [[Holotable]] was the earlier downloaded tabletop many players used. In June 2018 he stepped away, and the [[Players Committee]] took over management.<ref name="gemp2018" /> The Community Card lists him as a 2017 Advocate Award winner, "Creator of GEMP".<ref name="card" />

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 3 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Troy Biesterfeld (3 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Set 6]], [[Virtual Set 7]] and [[Virtual Set 11]], sets dated 2017–2019 on this wiki. The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Troy Biesterfeld|Card Credits]].
